name: local-npm
description: Multi-platform open source analytics and interactive visualization web application.
compose:
services:
    verdaccio:
        image: verdaccio/verdaccio:5
        ports:
            - 4873:4873
        volumes:
            - source: ./conf
              target: /verdaccio/conf
              type: bind
volumes:
    verdaccio:
        driver: local

source_files.content:
